WITH group_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    e.link_to_budget,
    b.event_status, 
    AVG(e.cost) as group_avg 
  FROM expense e 
  JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id 
  GROUP BY e.link_to_budget, b.event_status
),
overall_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg 
  FROM group_avgs
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    event_status, 
    group_avg
  FROM group_avgs, overall_avg_val
  WHERE group_avg > overall_avg_val.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  event_status,
  AVG(group_avg) as avg_of_group_avgs,
  AVG(group_avg) - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_val) as avg_deviation
FROM filtered_groups
GROUP BY event_status
ORDER BY event_status
